purpose: Executable smoke checks of the same definitions whose all-size correctness is kernel-proved. Not a machine-time or expander-existence test.
source:
import TransposeFollowup.RationalInverse
open TransposeFollowup

def identityMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def doubleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 2
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1 / 2
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def fractionalMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 1
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def outgoing (F : RationalMobius) : List (List Nat) :=
  (List.finRange 8).map (fun i => ((F.neighbors i).image Fin.val).sort (· ≤ ·))
def incoming (F : RationalMobius) : List (List Nat) :=
  (List.finRange 8).map (fun i => ((F.incomingNeighbors i).image Fin.val).sort (· ≤ ·))
#eval (outgoing identityMap, incoming identityMap)
#eval (outgoing doubleMap, incoming doubleMap)
#eval (outgoing fractionalMap, incoming fractionalMap)
validation: Observed outgoing/incoming lists match their expected exact interval intersections; all three pairs are transposes. Kernel theorems mem_neighbors and mem_incomingNeighbors cover arbitrary sizes.
